purpose: Diagnostic only, no model selection or website promotion
primaryComparison: exact4 minus exact3 reach1536 paired difference
secondaryComparison: exact3 minus current3 isolates node-budget fallback
stop: first1536 or actual death; guard6000 must never truncate
search: same score objective and leaf model; exact policies must finish every requested depth; no wall limit
sampleCaveat: 512 paired seeds is diagnostic for large effects; cannot establish equivalence or rule out ~1pp changes
fitAudit: Compare frozen base and all V7 candidates on previous teacher labels. Then pure supervised teacher fitting with3 shuffle seeds, grouped heldout split, fixed 1/10/100 epochs; assess training and heldout RMSE and normal-state value drift. This is learnability/generalization diagnosis, not online replay-dose efficacy.
noNewTeacherClaim: Existing teacher targets optimize score, not reach1536. Higher search depth is not assumed superior.
